title: IllegalArgumentException when switching the target PlayerView on Xiaomi MIBOX3 devices. Works when codecNeedsSetOutputSurfaceWorkaround set to true
body:
Issue description
-------------------------
When switching the target PlayerView the player stops playing with an IllegalArgumentException (similar to #4468/#6899/#8014/#8030). 

**We applied the output surface workaround for this device and confirmed the issue has gone.
Please include a new device model for the output surface workaround.**

```
diff --git a/library/core/src/main/java/com/google/android/exoplayer2/video/MediaCodecVideoRenderer.java b/library/core/src/main/java/com/google/android/exoplayer2/video/MediaCodecVideoRenderer.java
index 5908c6ff8f..996437d553 100644
--- a/library/core/src/main/java/com/google/android/exoplayer2/video/MediaCodecVideoRenderer.java
+++ b/library/core/src/main/java/com/google/android/exoplayer2/video/MediaCodecVideoRenderer.java
@@ -1604,6 +1604,7 @@ public class MediaCodecVideoRenderer extends MediaCodecRenderer {
         case "magnolia":
         case "machuca":
         case "oneday":
+        case "once":
           return true;
         default:
           break; // Do nothing.
```

Reproduction steps
-------------------------
- Create a layout with 2 player views
- Instantiate a simple ExoPlayer app and have it run a video on one of them
- Switch between the two views

Device info
-------------------------
- MANUFACTURER: Xiaomi
- MODEL: MIBOX3
- DEVICE: once
- SDK_INT: 28


ExoPlayer version
-------------------------
2.12.3

A full bug report captured from the device
-------------------------
It's not possible to collect bug reports using adb, because it was reported on the user device, but we have error stacktrace collected from logs
